title: Tenho quem! — trusted local pros in Madeira, with translation
metaDesc: Furniture assembly, appliances, doors, small repairs, moving. Only pros recommended by someone who worked with them. Your message goes out in Portuguese. Free.
heroTitle: Need someone you can trust? I've got someone!
heroSub: Local pros that someone has already tried and recommends. Pick the job — your message goes out in Portuguese.

jobsMsg.shelves: hanging curtain rails, shelves and pictures

whenMsg.asap: As soon as possible, if you can.

msgT: Hello {name}, I found your contact on Tenho quem! (seedwave.pt/quem). I need: {job}. {when} When can you come? Thank you!
none: No trusted pro for this yet.
pending: The contact appears as soon as the pro confirms.
report: Something went wrong? Tell the person who recommended
phrasesSub: Tap a phrase — your phone says it in Portuguese and shows it in large print.
voiceNote: No Portuguese voice on your phone? Just show the screen — the phrase is in large print.
how: 🤝 Not a directory: every pro has someone who worked with them and puts their name on it.
🌍 You write in your language — the pro gets the message in Portuguese on WhatsApp.
💶 No commissions, no sign-up. Free for the pro too: nothing to install.
honest: Prices are what the pro told us; always confirm before work starts. We are not an agency or a middleman.
gdpr: Are you a pro and want to be removed? Write to us — we remove you the same day.
